citation: Public Land Order 1070 of February 11, 1955, 20 FR 1055: full official Federal Register text (the order revoking EO 8915, and per the OFR catalog also EO 8992)
note: Mansfield b03 BLOCKED EO 8915 (1941 withdrawal of public lands for a War Department practice bombing and gunnery range, amended by EO 9526 of 1945). The only ending lead is the OFR disposition note 'Revoked by: Public Land Order 1070, February 11, 1955 (20 FR 1055)'; the PLO text is not held anywhere in the repository, so it cannot be confirmed that the acting text names EO 8915, which lands it restores, or its effective date (PLOs often state a later opening date). Route: the GovInfo Federal Register issue containing 20 FR 1055 (mid-February 1955). Any copy found is custody of a dated record, not authentication.

citation: Report of Presidential Emergency Board No. 199 (Long Island Rail Road; created by EO 12393 of November 16, 1982): the report's submission date to the President (cover and transmittal letter)
note: Mansfield b03 BLOCKED EO 12393. Its sec. 1-104 ('The Emergency Board shall terminate ninety (90) days after the submission of the report provided for in paragraph 1-102 of this Order.', jobs/fr-originals/data/full_run/texts/EO_12393.txt) is an own-term, report-relative end of the board, earlier than the EO 12553 revocation of 1986-02-25; its date needs the actual report submission date, which is not held. Expected route: NMB emergency-board table row and report PDF (https://nmb.gov/NMB_Application/wp-content/uploads/2025/05/PEB-199-Report.pdf, PEB number stated in the order's own title). Index values are not report dates; a found report is custody of a dated record, not authentication.
